solutionSql:
SELECT status, COUNT(*)::integer AS scans
FROM shipment_scans_large
WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 200
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status;
ambiguities: The starter selects status, id, and id is not in resultColumns, so I replaced it with the aggregate query.
notes: Changed: the revised ticket asks for scans as an integer, so COUNT(*) is cast with ::integer. It was bigint (OID 20) before. The result is now status text (OID 25) and scans integer (OID 23). Each status has 50 scans on all three datasets.
